question_record.context: A multi-stage security incident involving potential human-operated malicious activity was observed, which might lead to ransomware or other payloads installed on target devices. As part of this incident, the file `rubeus.exe` was used to dump Kerberos tickets on host `vnevado-win10b` by account `kyleg` with IP address `141.216.110.153`.
question_record.question: In the alert indicating possible use of the Rubeus kerberoasting tool, which SID was associated with the suspicious account activity?
solution: Possible human-operated malicious activity was observed involving the file `adminticket.txt`.
The Rubeus kerberoasting tool might have been used on an endpoint involving an account with SID `S-5-7-21-1843151660-3234030288-105586167-1422`.

105.name: Potential human-operated malicious activity
105.description: A sequence of alerts that might be indicative of human operated malicious activity was observed on this device. This activity might lead to ransomware or other payloads installed on target devices.

107.name: Possible use of the Rubeus kerberoasting tool
107.description:
Activity indicating the use of the Rubeus tool was observed on this endpoint. This tool can perform kerberoasting, pass-the-ticket, and other attack techniques that take advantage of Kerberos authentication.

During these attacks, attackers often request Kerberos tickets for an account's service principal name (SPN). They then decrypt the tickets to get plaintext credentials associated with the account. Alternatively, they can perform the pass-the-ticket technique to authenticate directly without having to decrypt the obtained tickets.

interpretation.scope: official graph witness, not a proof of causality, actor identity or autonomous planning

steps.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT o.AlertId, o.AlertTitle, o.ObservedAt, o.EntityIndex,
       o.GraphValue AS value, o.RawComponents, o.Roles, o.SourceRowHash,
       i.GraphValue AS matched_input
FROM LTMInputEvidence i
JOIN LTMEntityEvidence o ON o.SourceRowHash = i.SourceRowHash
WHERE i.AlertTitle = %s
  AND i.Concept = 'Account_AAD_ID' AND o.Concept = 'Command_File_Mention'
  AND i.GraphValue IN (%s)
ORDER BY o.AlertId, o.SourceRowHash, o.EntityIndex, o.GraphValue, i.GraphValue
LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT o.AlertId, o.AlertTitle, o.ObservedAt, o.EntityIndex,
